name: Oppein Home Group Inc.
summary: Oppein Home Group Inc. operates as a cabinetry manufacturer in China and internationally. The company offers whole house solutions; kitchen cabinets; bedroom solutions, including wardrobes and walk-in closets, kid's rooms, nightstands, dressers and chests, and beds; bathroom solutions comprising vanities, shower rooms, bathtubs, and toilets; interior and WPC doors; Ready-To-Assemble cabinets; and aluminum doors and windows. It markets its products under the OPPEIN, MIFORM, OPPOLIA, BAUNIS, and OPLONI brand name.
